purpose: Obtain a provider-neutral held-out diagnostic for the three failure masks responsible for nearly all of the declared selection stress, without changing or replacing the canonical 5,000-flight validation design.
population_boundary: The frozen 5,000-flight canonical sample of durable complete, supported and successfully first-pass-modelled pre-gate flights; upstream ingestion exclusions remain outside this design.

target_allocation.selection: At least one canonical control from every 0000 stratum, then capacity-limited allocation that greedily maximises the reduction in the sum of squared second-stage weights; within stratum select the lowest SHA-256 ranks under the frozen namespace.

control_selection.allocation: one per canonical 0000 stratum, then assign each remaining row to the available stratum with largest N_h^2 / (m_h * (m_h + 1)); this greedily minimises the sum of squared final weights and maximises Kish effective size
control_selection.second_stage_weight: canonical stratum population divided by targeted rows selected in that stratum
control_selection.reason: Deterministic, outcome-blind coverage of every canonical passing stratum; weights are retained for composition diagnostics, not for a release-wide correction.

strongly_preferred_fields: receiver or provenance class sufficient to assess overlap with adsb.lol
required_metadata: source name and immutable extract version
licence or written permission for research use
statement of receiver independence or explicit declaration that overlap is unverified
requested_external_extract.redistribution: No raw provider record is committed or published unless the provider explicitly permits it.

matching.runner_up_rule: Accept a non-singleton candidate set only when best_score <= 0.75 * second_best_score on both primary and source sides.

source_quality.aggregation: After exact position-time deduplication, median numerical states inside fixed Unix-minute bins and majority on-ground value.

proxy_model.observed_fuel: OpenAP 2.6.0 over the independent source trajectory using source ground speed.
proxy_model.wind: The frozen release ERA5 field and baseline code.
proxy_model.optional_secondary: An IAS/TAS-enhanced proxy may be reported separately when the source supplies it; it may not replace or retune the required ground-speed profile.

estimands.primary: For each targeted rejected mask separately, its targeted-design-weighted independent-source ratio-of-sums total-gap proxy minus the weighted 0000 control proxy, conditional on a unique match and frozen source-quality pass.
secondary: The corresponding lateral and vertical contrasts.
Matching, source-quality and measured-outcome response by requested mask.
The same contrasts without targeted-design weights as composition diagnostics.
estimands.missing_outcomes: No imputation. Thresholds control minimum descriptive support only; every contrast remains conditional on source response.
estimands.inference: Held-out targeted diagnostic. No p-value, confidence interval, release-wide correction or selection-bias bound.

decision_rule.complete_targeted_diagnostic: Every requested sample id has one declared status, every measured row passes the frozen matching and source-quality contract, and every mask meets its minimum measured-row threshold.
decision_rule.blocked: Any mask below threshold, artifact hash mismatch, gate information disclosed to matching, source protocol changed after access, or missing source declaration.
decision_rule.receiver_independence: A separate-source result with unverified receiver overlap remains exploratory; receiver independence may strengthen provenance but does not turn this targeted diagnostic into a release-wide bound.

pre_source_clarification.reason: The first protocol commit named matching thresholds but omitted the already intended score formula, and named weighted/unweighted diagnostics without declaring which was primary.
changes: Freeze the OpenSky-developed matching score and tie tolerance.
Declare the targeted-design-weighted ratio-of-sums contrast primary and the unweighted contrast secondary.

After a private-input-only allocation check, replace proportional second-stage control allocation with the pre-source variance-minimising discrete rule: Kish effective size rises from 529.20 to 539.92 of 600 controls and maximum weight falls from 4931 to 4898.

privacy: The public design contains aggregate allocation only. Private sample and match manifests remain outside git; only their SHA-256 digests and aggregate partitions may be registered.
